rules.source_quote: Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to following categories : Former and present holders of constitutional posts

All serving or retired officers and employees of Central / State Government Ministries / Offices / Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached offices / Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies
All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/- or more
All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
all land holding farmers’ families who are Non-resident Indians (NRIs) in terms of the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 shall be excluded from any benefit under the Scheme.
The benefit shall be paid to only those farmers’ families whose names are entered into the land records.
The cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries under the scheme shall be 01.02.2019
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.
rules.note: This rule is vague as it does not explicitly state that having a home loan is an exclusion criterion.
